nom: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser

avis.titre: Not a bad product but not my fave
avis.texte: I was given lots of travel size skincare as a present and this was in there. It doesn't remove makeup, but it's not supposed to because it's a morning cleanser to wash off all of your nighttime skincare. It does smell like REAL tea tree oil and that can be kinda strong or off putting to those that aren't used to it or don't like it. It didn't feel like it stripped my skin or like it was deep cleaning. It just felt like it was a basic face wash with tea tree. I typically prefer a deeper cleaning wash to control my oil but I used all of my travel size of this because there wasn't anything wrong with it.
So gentle on my skin and helps rid dirt on my skin from the day.
I get the dry flaky skin in the dry winter mornings on my OILY SKIN where oil clearing cleansers don't do that to me. Even when using a good moisturizer, it's stripping.
The cleanser may have washed my face but I couldn't get pass the heavy chemical smell so it was returned unfortunately.
I love that this face wash leaves my skin feeling clean but not dry. I've been using this product for a few years and I will continue to use this.

avis.titre: Caused Me Months of Breakouts + Irritation
avis.texte: Let me preface this review by stating that I like Corsrx as a brand and have had success with many of their other products in the past. I first tried them out back in 2015 when they were only available for purchase through a few Korean skin care importers such as Soko Glam ect. and thus I felt some level of confidence when picking out this cleanser. I have dry/combination skin that tends to lean on the sensitive side, but nothing about this cleanser gave me any indication that it would irritate my skin. Within a week or so my skin started to feel dry and my overall skin texture started to worsen. I started to get small white heads all over my forehead and hairline, and eventually started to get cystic breakouts on my forehead as well. At the time I attributed this to stress and poor diet, but even after making significant changes in an attempt to improve my skin nothing was changing. I have always had relatively clear skin and when I do breakout it's almost always hormonal and pops up around my period. This was very different. The breakouts were near constant and my skin seemingly worsened no matter what I tried externally or internally. About a week ago I started to really reflect on my routine, products, and any lifestyle changes that could have been causing my breakouts. I was exhausted and frustrated and was even considering seeing a doctor to see if I was suffering from some kind of hormone imbalance. I had a gut feeling that this cleanser could be the root cause of my p
2nd buy on this, Nice for morning wash, not heavy nor stripping for a fash wash.

I use this product morning and night and it feels amazing on my dry-prone skin. It feels light and clean on skin without causing dry skin after usage. It's simplified my skin care routine and I realized my problem was too many products. This is one and done cleanser.

It leaves you feeling clean! My skin feels ready and prepped for the rest of my skin care after using this cleanser. You definitely should still follow up with other skin care like the toner or moisturizer because it could leave your skin feeling dry. Don't just only cleanse.

My go to cleanser! I have normal/dry skin and I can use this night and day, it doesnt feel striping after use. It feels really gentle on the skin and my friends use it on sleepovers and bought it themselves. I have used this product for over a year now 10/10!

I bought this cleanser because the one I had been using for years (The Body Shop tea tree cleanser) is no longer availble. I liked that this also had tea tree in its ingredients. The smell is refreshing. I love that my skin doesn't feel stripped after using, however I have been experiencing some dryness (nothing a hydrating serum can't fix). I experienced some purging for about 2 weeks due to the BHA, but now my skin is beautifully clear!

It is better than many expensive cleansers, and while I can't state it solved my acne and postacne problem, I can confidently say it's been part of the routine that solved it. Initially I thought the smell was weird, but I got used to it

Cleans well, and feels noce on skin. However the smell is so over powering when washing my face. I almost tradhed the product bc of the smell, but I didnt want to waste money. So Im going to use it till its gone. Bit its going to be tough.

ive struggled with acne my entire life, and let me tell you this cleanser was a game changer. everyones skin is different, so what works for me is not gonna worm for everyone, but I had acne and acne scars that looked a million times less red and inflamed after using this wash just once. I use it night (i know its meant for morning) AFTER removing my makeup with micellar water, i wouldn't recommend just cleansing your face with this, make sure you get all the makeup off first. it leaves my skin feeling smooth, evens out the tone, and has seriously reduced acne so well. i highly recommend giving it a try if youve had persistent, full face acne.
I have combination but more leaning to dry skin and this cleanser did not work for me. It made my skin so dry and felt stripped, it also broke me out

Had very high expectations for this brand. But ever since I started using this, I had break outs (I never have breakouts) and feels my skin has been stripped. I have combination skin just fyi for the girls that are looking to try this.
I used this product once the smell was too overwhelming and making me gag. It smells like pesticides you put on your garden. Maybe this product really does work but i couldnt get passed the smell.
It makes me skin feel sooo clean! And gets rid of any acne inflammation! It does have a strong tea tree smell and can be drying if used twice a day!

avis.titre: I wanted to like it but….
avis.texte: The tea tree smell is strong but i personally find it soothing. I love cosrx and their snail mucin cleanser and decided to give this a try, i didn't want to believe the reviews but this breaks you out baaad. I can use every product under the sun and my skin has never gotten irritated or broke out but this broke me out on my chin bad and my sister on her cheeks. I think I'm going to throw it away out give it away.

avis.titre: Don't use this if you have dry skin.
avis.texte: I actally love the smell of this product. (Tea tree oil). It doesn't bother me but the actual product is incredibly stripping to the skin and I have oily skin which this product got rid of but now my skin is flaky due to the dryness that it has caused. I would recomend this to be used with an oily cleanser and not as a daily morning and night cleanser.

my skin was getting clear before i used this. after i used it i broke out on my cheeks on the left and right side of my chin area as well as my forehead. the tea tree smell is really strong too. if you want a good cleanser get the snail mucin cleanser

Idk if I got a wonky batch or something, but this smelled awful. Like mildew. It was a bummer, because the few times that I powered through the off-putting smell, it felt nice on my skin and didn't dry it out.

I don't normally write reviews, but I was repurchasing this for the fourth time so I might as well. The first time I used this I really enjoyed it. Great in the morning, refreshing, not drying, gentle but cleansing. Also works at night when double cleansing with a cleansing oil. Never broke me out, could always use it even when my skin was freaking out. After I used it up I got another cleanser, but went back to this when I realized don't need to fix what's not broken. Does exactly what you want from a cleanser.

This is my second time using this product and i was hesitant as i have sensitive skin. This morning my large pores are almost non existent. My face feels tighter and clean. A little product goes a long way. Definitely will be repurchasing!
If you love the smell of tea tree oil this cleanser is for you. It is not an overpowering smell but just enough. I love this cleanser, I am on my second bottle.

I use this strictly for my morning cleanse where I'm not trying to remove oils or heavy makeup. The foaming quality is so soft and nice. It has a pleasant smell which is a bonus. It makes my skin feel soft and clean. I highly recommended and will continue to repurchase.

This cleanser works perfectly well. It isn't drying or irritating. I don't notice any remarkable benefits either but it leaves my skin feeling clean. It doesn't have any bad smell—if anything, I think it smells like 7Up or Sprite.
I really like the cleaning part of it but the smell is really bad. It smells like rubber or like a car tire. I hope they fix it. Thats the only issue i have with this.

I honestly really wanted to like this cleanser but man did it reallyyyy break me out. I literally have pimples in places I never have before. It also made my skin itch and just feel irritated. It literally looks like I have a rash on my face and some pimples even look like welts… it's embarrassing. Totally messed up my skin :( It's a hard no for me.

This cleanser saved my skin almost immediately, after a bad experience with mixing rentinol & other actives. My skin was extremely dry and patchy with chemical burn. I immediately switch my cleanser and seen results within first use. Has now been my go to and I will not be going back.
Upon first using this i could not believe how strong the scent was. Stung my face when i used it and caused my face to look so red i looked like a tomato. No thanks. Will be returning.

Started using this product about a month ago and I'm very impressed. I have very sensitive, combination skin and I struggle with finding a good cleanser. This cleanser leaves my skin bright, refreshed, and clean and provides a cool soothing feeling while cleansing. The only thing I dislike about this product would be the smell.

i love this cleanser. it didn't dry out my skin, which is what usually happens. it also didn't cause any redness or pain, as i've had happen with some cleansers. some people said it smelled bad, but it was just tea tree oil which i think smells good. overall it was very soothing and i will definitely be incorporating it into my routine.
Thus Cleanser has been great, non drying even for winter and my cystic acne has improved since starting it, don't know if it's because of the wash but I don't have any complaints

avis.titre: Smells horrible but Ive seen a difference
avis.texte: This is my first day using it so my review is definetly not accurate. It has a floor cleaner strong smell that I hate. Also, its hard to wash off your eyebrow area? (Don't know why.) Otherwise this cleanser seems good. My skin seems brighter.

avis.titre: Great if want natural dewy skin
avis.texte: Paired with the right moisturizer/highlighter = nice dewy skin. I get a lot of compliments now

avis.titre: BEWARE IF YOU DEAL W/ CYSTIC ACNE
avis.texte: Beware if you have hormonal, cystic, oily/combo/very sensitive skin. Absolutely ruined the progress that was established. Caused my face to be in so much pain and cystic acne to develop. Never dealt w/ white heads before until starting this. Only used it 5 days and was the worst face wash I've ever used in my life
I have been using this for a month now and I have noticed my skin feels a lot cleaner and softer. The smell is a bit strong for my personal preferences but besides that I highly recommend

This cleanser is gentle and so refreshing! Great for mornings especially as it gives you a crisp happy wake up call. This cleanser is great for sensitive skin and for those using heavy products like retinol or tret. I keep this cleanser on rotation for when I need a pretty wake me up.

I've only been using this for a week, but I can see and feel a difference! I was looking for a face wash with some extra oomph because my skin needs some more TLC. I also didn't want something so harsh. I use it morning and night, and the second I used it I noticed my face was feeling smoother. Would recommend!!

I love how my skin is with this cleanser. I have been using it for around 10 years and usually repurchase every 5-6 months. I love how it works with my senistive, acne prone skin. This cleanser doesn't foam up a bunch. I find it is less stripping and more gentle on the skin. It cleanses well. It will remove minor face makeup but not mascara or a full face. I would recommend using a micellar water or a balm to remove heavy makeup first, but occasionally I forget and use it after and that works too. Tl;dr: A++ cleanser, good for acne prone skin, and if I didn't have it I would cry
I have sensitive skin and saw this was being recommended for oily sensitive skin but it gave me so many tiny white heads on my cheeks and made my face itch!

I used this twice and had a severe reaction to the fragrance each time. The cleanser itself worked well and left my skin soft, but I will be returning because the fragrance is too much to my skin. If you have sensitive skin - avoid this. If you don't, this will probably work for you.

avis.titre: Doesn't compare to anything else! Love!
avis.texte: When I first purchased this product I had terrible redness and wanted something calm to for my sensitive skin. I did try the dermalogica calm water gel first - which made my skin redness worse. I use this morning and evening and have bought at least 6 tubes. My skin loves it and I love the ingredients. I won't use anything else. Normal/Oily t-zone. Hormonal/Cystic Acne. Dehydrated/Sensitive skin.

Does what it is supposed to without stripping the skin but just be careful when you get it near your eyes. It's a given that any soap will burn your eyes but I know some cleansers get into your eye easier than others sometimes. This is one of them.

I use this every day, twice a day. I have never noticed a weird smell or strong smell. I've been using this for years now. My skin is super oily and this leaves me feeling normal and clean. It foams up very nicely and does not strip my skin after washing. I hope this works as well for you as it did for me!

I love this cleanser! I've been using it for a couple weeks and it's been very refreshing. The only thing I want to mention is that my skin does feel a little dry/tight after using it, buts it's not a problem after I moisturize. It also has a scent, not super strong, but still noticeable. I personally like it but it might bother some people.

I've used a range of foam cleansers over the last 5 years and they tend to dry my out. This cleanser goes from gel to foam and is super gentle on the skin. It doesn't give me tight skin after. A little bit goes a long way, too. I use it in the night and sometimes in the morning. This is now a staple in my routine.

I love this cleanser. It worked very well for me and my very sensitive/oily skin. I liked the texture and how it smelled, it felt very fresh and the product worked well. It helped reduce my mask acne. I definitely recommend it!
It's a really great gentle cleanser that didn't irritate my sensitive skin, I definitely would purchase again!

This cleanser is no joke! Gentle, cleansing, and so great. I use in the morning and the Salicylic Acid Daily Gentle Cleanser in the evening. But this could certainly be used at morning and night. Rinses cleanly, no buildup, and very lightly scented. Never stop making this!
it doesn't dry your skin out. i was really scared to try new products because my skin hasn't been that great lately but there hasn't been a reaction lately so that's a good sign.
decided to try it since I have extremely sensitive skin & its fantastic! super clean feeling without drying or stripping my skin. has helped with my acne & makes my skin feel really soft

I have been using this cleanser since 2019 and still love it. I had a big break out during junior year in hs and it was so bad. I have oily skin and acne prone. I didnt know what cleansers to help with oil production until i try this. Of course it wont remove makeup because it's a gentle cleanser lmao. use it after your makeup remover. If you feel like your skin is dry from the weather, use less amount and use moisturizer (cosrx rice sleeping mask is so good!). this cleanser helped control my oil and i cannot thank you enough. if you have oily and sensitive skin, buy this! My skin is so much better now only hormonal acnes.

I love using Korean skincare products. CosRX is a wonderful and well known Korean skincare brand. Their products are amazing, but this cleanser is a big fat no for me! The cleanser dries out my skin, and my skin is screaming for hydration after every use.

I won't use it again. I think it's too stripping for my skin. In the summer it isn't as stripping as the winter and it gives me a fresh feeling but I won't be using it regardless. I think there are better cleansers out there. I only use a very very little amount that creates a great lather, so I know that I am not using too much.

I believe this contains a small percentage of salicylic acid and has helped diminish my pores and the blackheads on my nose. It is definitely gentle and not stripping. I have hormonal acne and it hasn't purged my skin, if anything it has helped :)
cleans my skin without irritating it or making it feel stripped and dry. I never have breakouts with this and gets rid of whatever makeup is left from my oil cleanser.
I am someone who has sensitive skin and breakout very easily. I've tried Cerva, Tula, Origins, Tatcha, and this is the only cleanser that does not break me out or leaves my skin dry. I love it!
Love this cleanser for face and body. It is.my go to for whenever I need some aromatherapy and it fills my need everytime.
I love this product. Great to wash away any sleep from the night before and leaves me feeling fresh and ready for the day.

I've been using this cleanser for a few years now, and I have to say that my skin clears up when I use it a few times. Some people say it has an "odd smell" but its just the smell of the tea tree. If you've never smelled tea tree before, then you'll think it has a sort of medicine-y, earthy smell. It's not overpowering, and it goes away when you wash it off. This never leaves my skin dry and I notice it makes my skin softer too. Only thing is that the lid doesnt close all the way once you've used it for a while ( it doesnt "click" close.) but thats usually towards the end of me using the product. Would highly recommend for oily and acne prone skin. I'm prone to skin allergies and this doesn't trigger any. But as always, patch test before using.

avis.titre: low ph good morning gel cleanser
avis.texte: works well i use it at night instead of morning so that i feel refreshed before i go to bed plus it smells really good :) also u only need about a dime sized amount for ur whole face so no need in buying a bigger tube

I use it at night, before applying retinol. It doesn't irritate or dry the skin dbecause of it's low pH formula. There's a light lather. It rinses easily. I don't wear makeup, but I'm not sure this would remove it. This formula might be too light for makeup. There's no perfume-y scent. It just smells like tea tree oil.

avis.titre: I didn't know what to expect..
avis.texte: Hi all! To start off, I have sensitive combination skin and I'm a 22 y/o city dweller. When I first started using it, I automatically felt a difference from the facial wash I was using prior to the pH balancing cleanser. I started to double cleanse just recently, and noticed my skin getting a little drier than normal after my second wash. I was looking for a good cleanser that mainly calmed my face. (My acne is calming down finally I get acne still but toned down acne if that makes sense. And thought I might get into retinoids soon. I dont know. But I wanted to give my skin some time to breathe.) and this did exactly that! It leaves my skin feeling so moisturized even after a wash. It's soft and silky yet also refreshing. I'm confused. I've never had a moisturizer that made my skin feel like this. I've been using it at night for 2 weeks while I use my old one in the morning (just to finish it off and slowly get it into my skin care routine) but I'm really excited to make it my main wash to see if it does anything more. But yeah! Great wash! I would definitely buy again and recommend to a friend. Sorry for the long review lol. I don't write them normally but I really like it so far and thought it might be helpful for people that are on the fence. :)

avis.titre: Smells like old man moth balls
avis.texte: I wanted to love this so much because everyone on youtube raves about cosrx. switched out for philosophy mattifying cleanser. I kept the toner and the white head power liquid. the smell is nasty. nothing like crawling into bed wreaking of moth balls. throwing this away. waste. philosophy mattifying cleanser is 1,000 times better!!
sucked. gave me so many white heads and i used this in the morning, it rly showed my skin texture and flaws. but it mainly just broke me out with white heads.

avis.titre: Best face wash I've ever used!
avis.texte: My favorite brand and face wash. The gel turns into a good foam
This is the second time I'm using it, does it really have a funny horrid "gasoline" smell. It's scary.

avis.titre: Started clearing up after two uses!
avis.texte: I bought as apart of the sample pack. I was shook by how quick it starting clearing up my skin. I have acne towards my jawline that never clears up. It's a mixer of zits and the painful pimples that form under the skin that can't be popped. I'm on day four of using this stuff and it's almost all completely gone! I'm also very prone to dry, inflamed, irritated skin when using products, although I would recommend using a moisturizer after this, my skin didn't really dry out like it has with most products. I also had no redness or irritation. My completion looks great after using this, it's very even-toned. Also, I only use about a pea sized dollop each time and it's spreads really well. The only downside to this product so far is that it doesn't have the greatest smell.

avis.titre: Not the best, very drying for my oily skin
avis.texte: I have oily skin, and it fully dries me out. It also has a STRONG smell. Not a fan.
It's gentle, my skin seems to be responding well to it, I only need a little bit to go a long way. I've really enjoyed the product! Wish the packaging were more sustainable somehow!

I've been in beauty for 20+ years and, for whatever reason, I am brand new to K-beauty. Where have I been? - CosRx does a great job of formulating effective products at a very great price. I am super picky when it comes to a daily cleanser. It must remove light makeup easily, must not strip the skin, and it shouldn't leave residue behind. Well--Check, check and check. I wear a tinted SPF and this cleanser removes it all, leaving my skin soft and ready for a second cleanse or my softener. The smell is strong however after a few weeks of using it I began to look forward to it. Great price, huge bottle.

I just started puberty, and this helped clear up my normal to oily skin. great for teens. for the people that say this is drying out their skin, this is incorrect. you must use a moisturizer after cleansing your skin, and if you don't, every cleanser will not satisfy you. this is also great for my skin because of how gentle it is. a must!

First of all, i love the smell, it isn't a strong smell of fragrance but it doesn't stink of chemical either. Secondly, it foams up wonderfully and leaves my skin feels comfortable and soft after washing~ what a great way to start mornings!

this has become an essential part of my daily and nightly routines. it cleans well and doesn't leave my face too dry. it pairs nicely with any oil cleanser for double cleansing after wearing makeup or sunscreen.

This is a good face wash for day to day use. It always manages to fix break outs and I've never had problems with it drying my skin. If you wash your face twice a day I recommend using this once a day and using a more mild wash anytime after.

avis.titre: Nice gentle cleanser at a good price
avis.texte: The smell is a little intense at first, but this is a really nice gentle cleanser. I tried this as part of the cosRX sample pack and I would definitely buy the full size of this product.

This cleanser is gentle and leaves my skin feeling super soft and hydrated after use. I love that I can smell the tea tree but it's a little lighter and more sweet than astringent. So far it works wonderfully for both my Husband and me. I have normal to dry skin, and he is very oily and prone to cystic acne. We will for sure be buying this again.

I bought this some time ago and I made the commitment to use the whole bottle until it ran out daily to see how my skin would feel. I have oily/combo skin and I used it mostly around summer. What can i say, it does the job and it feels really refreshing. There's nothing more than that. I don't really have puffy skin in the morning so I couldn't tell if it was soothing, but the cool effect was definitely noticeable. I didn't really like the smell it had, which might be too much if you have a sensitive nose, but I used less than I do with my other cleansers and it was alright. Go on and get it

I use this for my water-based cleanser after using a balm cleanser, and it is so nice. I've been using this cleanser for around 2 years, and it has never had a negative effect on my skin. I have combination skin and it is very reactive to harsh cleansers, so i was worried that this would break me out because of the tea tree smell, but it doesn't. I can't say it fixes skin problems because i use more than just cleanser, but it is a very effective part of my routine for sure.

I got this cleanser in the acne sampler pack and I was really hesitant to try it. I'm 25 and have always had acne. I have very sensitive, oily-combination skin. I was using only CeraVe products and while they did fine it was not preventing breakouts. This is the first cleanser I've used where I haven't had a single new breakout in the week I've used it. It does leave my skin feeling just a smidge tight if I let my skin dry before applying toner, but my skin seems to love it. It is foaming but it is pretty gentle, I don't feel a tingle or sting. There is that tea tree oil scent but it does not linger. Buying the full sized bottle now!!

Using this cleanser for more than a month now. At first I didn't liked the smell of it. It is has some kinda chemical smell, which only lasts for 4-5 seconds.. But it made my skin so soft after the first wash.. Loving my skin after washing my face.. this is my first product from this brand.. looking forward to try more..

I purchased this product because I was looking for an everyday gentle cleanser but unfortunately when I use this cleanser it leaves my skin feeling tight and I immediately get tiny breakouts. I've used multiple times different weeks and still the breakouts pop up as soon as I use this. I tend to have acne prone skin so my skin just may react differently to this.
This cleanser is bomb!!! I used it as a body wash as well and it leaves me feeling clean and fresh. 10/10 highly recommend

I was so excited to try this cleanser. Unfortunately after a few uses I ended up with dry and broken out skin. After a trip to the dermatologist I found that this threw my moisture barrier and microbiome off so bad that I had to go on an oral medication to cure it.

I use this in the all times of the day morning, after my workout, and before bed. It hasn't left my skin feel tight and dry. It does have a slight scent and that scent is tea tree oil which I never was crazy about but it's growing on me The tea tree oil is an ingredient but it's very low on ingredient list so it's not that typical overwhelming scent

This cleanser came highly recommended from a friend I TRUST, & from its great score on the ThinkDirty app. I have slightly sensitive combination/more on the oily side skin. I use this in the AM & as my 2nd cleanser for PM after a balm. My boyfriend, who has very oily skin, uses it AM/PM as well. You only need a pea size amount & lathers so well! One tube lasted us both 4/5months, with all 4 uses daily! I use this in combination with a few other COSRX products (AHA/BHA toner, hylauronic essence, oil-free moisturizing lotion) & my skin is @ it's best. On the second tube now & still loving it! :o)
I started using this in korea & I noticed a big difference in my skin. This brand is fantastic!

avis.titre: Low pH Good Morning Gel C
avis.texte: Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser is an great face wash for my acnee prone and sensitive skin. It is easy to smooth across skin and it did a good job removing dirt, oil, and makeup, and rinsed cleanly.

My skin: oily, not sensitive, not very acne-prone but sometimes get 1-2 pimples if I haven't washed my face or changed my pillowcase after 2ish days. (Nasty, I know, but I'm home most of the time now because of covid.) I've gone through two tubes of this cleanser because it's consistently good for my skin. I think its pretty basic as a cleanser but that can be good depending on your skin needs. My face feels clean and supple after every wash--not stripping at all. And I mean, like, really supple. I use a salicylic cleanser for my PM routine but will use this one if I plan to use TO mask that night. The smell was weird at first but you get used to it (and my sister says it smells exactly like her tea tree oil. I wouldn't know but yeah). Lastly, amazing value: one tube lasts me at least four months because you really don't need a lot for it to foam up (I squeeze out half to 3/4 an inch per use). Totally recommend, even for sensitive peepers.

I really wanted to like this cleanser cause I love COSRX, but it just was not what I was expecting at all. I've never used a gel cleanser that foams up before so that was a surprise when I tried it. It also smells AWFUL. I'm so glad I got the sampler kit so I didn't end up with a regular size product that I would feel guilty for not using. It left my skin feeling tight and dry the one time I've used it. I also formed a cystic acne spot which I haven't had in a long time and this was the only new product that could have caused it. I have oily, acne-prone and sensitive skin and COSRX usually does it for me, but this was a major disappointment.

I really wanted to love this cleanser as it has gotten great reviews on many sites. But everytime I use it, my skin starts to get red and splotchy and starts to itch. I thought at first it was due to me using it while on a beach vacation. But I've tried it a 2nd and 3rd time since and still getting the same reaction. Another note, this cleanser smells horrible! Thankfully it wasn't too expensive so don't feel bad about not using.

avis.titre: This is a DO NOT purchase.
avis.texte: I have combo, sensitive skin. I get breakouts during my period, and large pores, but generally pretty okay. I've been incorporating new products into my routine and this is a HARD no. It immediately dried my skin out - flaky and dull after three washes. I have some enormous, painful pimples from this face wash, that will take awhile for my skin to heal from. I'm planning on returning it, because I wouldn't gift this to my worse enemy.
I use a lot of heavy moisturizing products at night and this does a deep clean without stripping my skin.

I am kind of a skincare junkie, so I try out a lot of cleansers. I tried this one a couple of years ago when I was really just getting into skincare. I liked that it was low pH and foamed up, but that was about it. It didn't hit me until recently that this has always been my old reliable cleanser, my best friend that I didn't realize I was in love with until halfway through the movie. Regardless of how many I try, I always end up coming back to this one. I have never been without a tube of this stuff. It's my ol' faithful. It doesn't dry out my skin at all, and it works for me, no matter what season it is or what my skin is going through. It's seen my try out retinols and vitamin C, and it's still the cleanser I repurchase again and again.

After reading some comments and doing some diligent research on this product, I was a bit skeptical to give it a try. Since my other morning cleanser the Neogen Fresh Foam Green Tea cleanser started to strip my skin, I opted in for this. Let me tell you, how much this changed my life! I'm already on my third bottle. Just wanted to make this clear to anyone that is reading reviews. Everyone's skin is different, and once you begin to use a new product. Your skin will start purging it self. But don't mix this up with your skin having a bad reaction. Nonetheless, I love that this cleanser has a low PH level. It's super skin barrier friendly, and the best part to this is, it's fragrance free. The only essential oil, is basically Tea Tree, which make up for it's slight scent, which is amazing. Since some cleanser's have just an over powering aroma.

I love this cleanser, I got my first one from Soko glam but it's always sold out on there so I decided to buy my next two from ulta. This cleanser along with my other skincare products has literally saved my skin. Being stuck at home has caused me to be really stressed out which has led to more breakouts. This has been a life saver and I will continue to purchase as long as it is available.

I bought this in the mini version to try out , the smell was absolutely horrid , it worked but not as well as my other morning cleansers I've used before which was a shame .... I really wanted to like it
This dried my skin out and broke me out like crazy, my skin calmed down a day after I stopped using it

I'm always on the lookout for a nice, gentle, fragrance free facial cleanser. This one did not disappoint. I think it really did the job, making my face feel clean without being tight. It has a nice natural scent, and I'd definitely consider repurchasing it in the future.

I have very oily skin and this has been my go-to cleanser for several years. It use in the evenings after using an oil/balm to remove my makeup and sunscreen, and it thoroughly cleanses without stripping or overdrying (you can overstrip even oily skin!). I love it!

Been doing skincare for 5 years now and have gone through so many cleansers, cheap and expensive. This is by far the best one I've ever tried. I have oily skin and this is just so perfect. It cleanses without drying out my skin and smells great, and I just love how nice it looks on my counter too :) highly recommend!

I ordered this with the CosRX snail cream. I will say it does a really good job of cleaning my skin in the morning, it doesn't leave me feeling tight or dry. In fact, my skin looks very even and glowy after I rinse. Decent leather. I haven't tried to use this after wearing makeup yet, but I can tell it'll give a good thorough clean after a makeup remover.
Love this as a second cleanse after a cleansing oil/balm. Feels gentle on my skin, I have dry/combo skin and I don't find it stripping or harsh.

avis.texte: For me this is basic cleanser that doesn't irritate my skin. I love it! My skin is reallly easy to irritate which means it's difficult to properly clean and moisturize. This is a great morning cleanser for anyone with acne-prone skin. It's pretty cheap considering the quality .

This cleanser instantaneously brightened up my rosacea prone skin, didn't give me any breakouts or an overstripped feeling. And a bottle goes a long way! Overall, I recommend this for sensitive skin.

I have oily and acne prone skin. I wanted to try this cleanser since many people were raving on how its so good for oily skin. So i tried it for 6 months and it fried out my face. I'm pretty sure it contributed to blackheads on my cheeks. It did leave my face feeling smooth but made me really dry. Maybe i was not using it correctly but it did not work for me.

avis.titre: Was Looking For A Morning/Gentle Cleanser and.....
avis.texte: It gets the job done! Didn't expect it to lather but it does. It does have a stronger smell but nothing unbearable. If you are looking for something that will leave your skin refreshed and a little less dry then this probably wont be for you. I personally am content with the feeling as I have a good moisturizer. I would recommend it to anyone looking to get a gentle cleanser (:

I use this in the shower or at my sink. I get my face wet, get it on my hands, and go at it. I really like this product! It's easy to use and has really helped my skin improve! I have less breakouts than I used to which is great!
